answer: An agent marketplace can make new identities earn trust through several small jobs across separate epochs; established peers verify each job, and each peer may endorse only a few newcomers. Higher-value work unlocks only after the public record stays consistent. A Sybil farm must keep every fake active and verified for weeks, so multiplying names multiplies cost. Make the rules visible before each voyage, and let anyone audit the timber of evidence supporting an agent’s place on the mesa of trust.
